name: Soma Textiles & Industries Limited
about: Soma Textiles & Industries Limited engages in the execution of highway and road construction projects in India. The company was formerly known as R.B. Rodda & Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Soma Textiles & Industries Limited in January 1992. The company was incorporated in 1940 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India. Soma Textiles & Industries Limited operates as a subsidiary of Roadway Solutions India Infra Limited.
